title: gibbsReactor operation
description: Gibbs reactor: equilibrium composition from minimising the total Gibbs free energy subject to atom-balance constraints. Three selectable `model` paths: elementPotential (gas), reactiveFlash (multi-condensable, NRTL) and directMin (multi-start Nelder-Mead).

T.title: Operating temperature
T.description: Temperature at which the equilibrium is evaluated.

P.title: Operating pressure
P.description: Pressure at which the equilibrium is evaluated; enters the ideal-gas chemical potential mu = mu_pure(T) + RT ln(y_i P / 1 bar).

elements.title: Atomic elements
elements.description: Chemical elements for the atom-balance constraints (one per element). Each species lists its atom counts in this order.

species.title: Candidate species
species.description: Candidate species in the equilibrium mixture, each with its atom counts (one per element).

name.title: Component name (must be in the declared component set)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: isothermal (default; `T` holds and the duty is the result) or adiabatic. In adiabatic mode `T` is the Newton's SEED, not the answer.

Q.title: Imposed duty
Q.description: Heat added per kmol of feed, for a non-adiabatic non-isothermal case; defaults to 0.

temperatureApproach.title: Equilibrium approach magnitude (direction assigned by the engine)
temperatureApproach.description: Detune the equilibrium by THIS MANY kelvin: the REACTION is evaluated at a shifted temperature while the physical state stays at T — enthalpy, Psat and the energy balance do not move. THE VALUE IS A MAGNITUDE AND THE ENGINE ASSIGNS THE SIGN (ruled 2026-09-26): it reads the thermicity of the overall transformation from the feed to its equilibrium at the physical T — the isothermal enthalpy change on the package's surface, never the published Q_kW — and evaluates at T + dT for an exothermic transformation (ammonia synthesis, shift: a higher temperature under-predicts it) and at T − dT for an endothermic one (steam reforming). It ANNOUNCES the direction and the thermicity it read, on the console and in the run's advisories, and publishes the SIGNED value it used as the KPI temperatureApproach_K. A negative declaration is REFUSED by name (a real bed never crosses its own equilibrium curve, so the approach has no sign of its own); minimum 0 is that rule. Announced, never judged: a feed already past the equilibrium at T (a quench stage) runs the transformation the other way and the approach lands on the feed's side. It is EMPIRICAL (calibrated against a real unit, never predicted) and GLOBAL (one number; it cannot resolve per-reaction approaches, so the OVERALL thermicity decides the direction), and at high pressure it will absorb missing fugacity corrections. (The 2026-09-25 description said the sign was the author's and deliberately had no lower bound; superseded by the ruling.)
